ana-devexp: Quick flag: our sample apps started breaking after the SDK npm publish changed to an exports map. Edge sample (workers + next edge) resolves the CJS path and runtime throws `TypeError: sdk_1.default is not a constructor`. TS also can't resolve types.

mike-sdk: Ugh. Which sample and which version?

ana-devexp: sample/edge-chat, version 1.3.0. Repro:
1) pnpm install @redwood/sdk@1.3.0
2) next dev (or wrangler dev)
3) call /api/generate -> runtime crash.

olivia-build: I dug into the tarball: dist/types missing from package, and package.json exports is only import/require. Some edge bundlers don't honor import conditional and fall back to require.

noah-bundler: We see a similar issue in our CI: esbuild + next's edge loader picks the CJS entry for some reason (maybe due to package entrypoints resolution order).

mike-sdk: Package.json snippet from published package:
```
{"name":"@redwood/sdk","version":"1.3.0","main":"dist/cjs/index.js","module":"dist/esm/index.js","types":"dist/types/index.d.ts","exports":{".":{"import":"dist/esm/index.js","require":"dist/cjs/index.js"}}}
```

olivia-build: Two problems: (1) shipping without dist/types in tarball -> TS users lose intellisense, (2) some edge runtimes pick require/CJS which breaks ESM-only usage patterns.

noah-bundler: Pragmatic fixes: add an `edge` conditional and include a `browser` entry; some bundlers prefer `browser`, others honor `edge`. Example:
```
"exports":{
  ".":{
    "edge":"dist/edge/index.mjs",
    "import":"dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "require":"dist/cjs/index.js",
    "default":"dist/esm/index.mjs"
  }
}
```

ana-devexp: Workaround in samples: pin to 1.2.x or add a webpack/esbuild alias pointing at dist/esm. Not great for onboarding.

mike-sdk: Action plan: 1) emergency patch to include dist/types and add files list in package.json 2) add `edge` conditional + `default` fallback for older bundlers 3) add a small integration test in edge CI that installs the published tarball and runs the sample.

olivia-build: I'll also update our publish script to run `npm pack` and smoke-test the tarball before publishing. Found a local script that missed copying types if build step failed — will harden it.

noah-bundler: FYI: let's add a note in docs about known resolver quirks and a troubleshooting snippet for Next/Vercel/Cloudflare. Saves users time.

doc-bot: Created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-repo/sdk/issues/523 with repro, CI logs, and suggested patch. Assigned to mike-sdk + olivia-build.

mike-sdk: I'll cut the patch tomorrow and include a changelog entry explaining the exports map change and the recommended sample pin. Thanks for catching this early. :heart:
